Q15.purpose: Conversion rate (orders per session) for paid_social traffic by month
Q15.sql:
WITH orders_month AS (
    SELECT date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS total_orders
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    WHERE o.product_id = 'P001'
      AND o.channel = 'paid_social'
      AND o.date >= '2026-08-01'
      AND o.date < '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM')
),
traffic_month AS (
    SELECT date_format(to_date(w.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           SUM(CAST(w.sessions AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sessions
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic w
    WHERE w.source = 'paid_social'
      AND w.date >= '2026-08-01'
      AND w.date < '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY date_format(to_date(w.date), 'yyyy-MM')
)
SELECT o.month,
       o.total_orders,
       t.total_sessions,
       CASE WHEN t.total_sessions = 0 THEN 0 ELSE o.total_orders / t.total_sessions END AS orders_per_session
FROM orders_month o
JOIN traffic_month t USING (month)
ORDER BY o.month

Q19.purpose: Orders per click by campaign (pre vs post fall_launch)
Q19.sql:
WITH daily_metrics AS (
  SELECT o.date,
         SUM(o.quantity) AS total_orders,
         SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS total_revenue,
         SUM(m.clicks) AS total_clicks
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend m
    ON o.date = m.date
   AND o.channel = 'paid_social'
   AND m.channel = 'meta'
   AND o.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY o.date
),
campaign_daily AS (
  SELECT date,
         total_orders,
         total_clicks,
         CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-16' THEN 'summer_evergreen' ELSE 'fall_launch' END AS campaign
  FROM daily_metrics
)
SELECT campaign,
       SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
       SUM(total_clicks) AS total_clicks,
       SUM(total_orders) / NULLIF(SUM(total_clicks), 0) AS orders_per_click
FROM campaign_daily
GROUP BY campaign

Q23.purpose: Calculate conversion rate (orders per session) for paid_social by country and month.

WITH sessions_month AS (

   AND o.channel = 'paid_social'

    AND wt.date >= '2026-08-01'
    AND wt.date <= '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY date_format(to_date(wt.date), 'yyyy-MM'), o.country
),
orders_month AS (
  SELECT o.country,
         date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  WHERE o.channel = 'paid_social'
    AND o.country IN ('US','GB','IN','CA','DE','AU')
    AND o.date >= '2026-08-01'
    AND o.date <= '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY o.country, date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM')
)
SELECT o.country,
       o.month,
       o.total_orders,
       s.total_sessions,
       CAST(o.total_orders AS DOUBLE) / s.total_sessions AS conversion_rate
FROM orders_month o
JOIN sessions_month s
  ON o.country = s.country
 AND o.month = s.month
ORDER BY o.country, o.month;
